name: MoxKit Addons for Elementor
author: moxtheme

sections.description:
MoxKit Addons for Elementor includes:

  • Navigation Menu with a WordPress menu selector, horizontal/vertical layouts, alignment, library icons, pointers, hover effects, and responsive hamburger navigation.
  • Custom navigation breakpoints in px, em, rem, %, vw, and vh. Tablet/Mobile follow Elementor site settings. Custom compares available widget width; % and vw refer to viewport width, vh to viewport height, em to widget font size, and rem to root font size.
  • Text Marquee, Image Marquee, Process Showcase, Statistics, Chart, Progress Steps, and Advanced Image.
  • Navigation Menu extras: 13 pointers, hover-intent, card, and mega submenus with descriptions, badges, and image cards, a vertical icon rail, search and a button in the menu, and a sticky, shrinking, hiding, or transparent header with scroll progress and one-page highlighting. On phones and tablets: six toggle styles, side, top, bottom, fade, or circle panels, drawer width, page effects, staggered items, and drill-down submenus.
  • Image Box with eight interactive banner designs; the whole box is one link.
  • Advanced Image scroll reveals: liquid swirl, wipe, iris, diamond, curtain, blinds, tiles, and brush.
  • Chart with vertical or horizontal bars, lines, areas, and donuts; value prefix/suffix and placement, wrapping labels, and a styleable donut center.
  • Advanced Rating with stars, hearts, circles, or any library icon on a 1–10 scale, exact or rounded fill, score formats, review count, and entrance animations.
  • Custom Heading built word by word: a font, color, gradient, image text mask, or outline for each word, images inside the text, markers (including bar and brush strokes that draw in), and part, word, letter, or typewriter animations with looping effects.
  • Button with 12 ready-made presets, 15 shapes, 16 hover effects, icon animations, attention loops, and click effects.
  • Video with YouTube, Vimeo, self-hosted media, optional click-to-load privacy, captions, and player controls.
  • Icon with default, stacked, or framed styles, layered filled pulses, outline ring pulses, glow, and hover or looping animations.
  • Icon Box, Call to Action, and Pricing Table.
  • Testimonial: one quote or many as a grid, carousel, moving row, or avatar picker, in 11 card designs with half-star ratings, highlighted words, and a rating summary.
  • Accordion / FAQ with smooth open/close animations and Normal, Hover, and Open title box styles.
  • Vertical Accordion with expanding desktop panels, vertical titles, and real editable Elementor Containers. Automatically stacks on mobile with horizontal headers, natural content height, configurable initial state, and keyboard navigation.
  • Team Member with photo, role, bio, rating badge, and social links in seven designs.
  • Flip Box with a two-sided card that turns over on hover/focus or click/tap/keyboard: 3D or elastic jelly flip, liquid morph (ripple, melt, wave, or swirl), a liquid blob growing from the pointer, paint drip, rising tide, or frosted dissolve.
  • Progress Bar with Basic, Label & status, Compact with metadata, and Circular layouts; status colors and optional scroll animation.
  • Process Showcase with icon, number, or icon + number badge markers, an optional button per step, and animated connectors (light beam, flowing dashes, travelling dot, or draw on scroll).
  • Pie Chart that animates into view.
  • Counter with ten number animations (count up with easing, odometer, slot machine, scramble, typewriter, wave, flip, drop, blur focus, or none), an icon on the left, right, top, or bottom, and a styleable content box for the number, title, and description.
  • Countdown timer to a date with an expiry message.
  • Post Categories: categories, tags, or any public taxonomy as a list (optionally nested), pills, cards, or count tiles, with one icon for all or an icon, color, and name per term, post counts, and the current category highlighted.
  • Popular Posts: most viewed, most commented, latest, recently updated, or random posts as a numbered list, text ranking, cards, image overlays, or a featured post with the rest beside or below it; stacked, side by side, or in a swipeable row. Rank numbers come as large, outlined, gradient, badge, ribbon, or watermark numbers, colored with one color, gold/silver/bronze, a blend from first to last, or a palette.

Liquid Glass (Extensions): turn any Container into glass under Style > Liquid Glass. The backdrop behind it is refracted through an SVG lens with edge shine (Chrome and Edge) or frosted (Safari and Firefox). Nine presets act as a quick mode and every value can be customized. The script loads only on pages that use it.

Custom Cursor (Extensions): change the cursor over a Container under Advanced > Custom Cursor. Pick a browser cursor, or a dot, trailing ring, ring, blend circle, spotlight glow, text bubble, or image that follows the pointer, with trailing, link-hover, and click effects. Touch screens are unaffected, and the script loads only on pages that use it.

MoxKit Waves (Extensions): seamless animated wave dividers for Containers and Sections under Style > MoxKit Waves. Six styles (ocean, layered, gentle curve, liquid blob, small ripples, big tide), up to three layers with their own colors and opacity, and flowing, rising-and-falling, or liquid motion. The waves are drawn so they repeat exactly, pause off screen, and stay behind the content unless you bring them to the front.

Animated Shape Divider (Extensions): bring Elementor’s own Shape Divider to life on Containers and Sections under Style > Shape Divider Animation: an endless sideways flow, tide, breathe, or sway, with an optional see-through second layer for depth.

Post View Counter (Extensions, off until you switch it on): counts how often each post is opened, for Popular Posts ranked by “Most viewed”. It stores one number per post and nothing about visitors; people who can edit the post, previews, link prefetches, and bots are not counted. Pages served from a full-page cache never reach WordPress, so they are not counted either; in that case use a caching-aware view counter plugin and enter its custom field in the widget.

Every widget includes Content and Style controls, responsive settings, typography, colors, and box styling. Elementor’s Advanced controls remain available. Elementor 3.25.0 or newer is required; Elementor Pro is not required.

Create reusable templates under MoxKit and assign a header and footer to the MoxKit Full Width page layout. Templates can contain any Elementor widgets. Optional automatic assignment covers standard WordPress pages; custom templates, Elementor Canvas, posts, archives, and WooCommerce special pages are excluded. This is a page layout builder, not a full archive/single-post theme builder.

The Navigation Menu supports a responsive dropdown or full-screen off-canvas panel that slides from the left or right. Full-screen panels include a close button and Escape support. Click parent menu text to toggle its submenu; branches stay open until toggled closed. Leaf links navigate normally. The main mobile dropdown retains its shadow; submenus have no default shadow. Default item gap is zero and styling controls remain available.

External services

MoxKit sends no telemetry and includes no remote font or icon CDN of its own. Elementor may load its configured assets independently.

Optional YouTube videos load from youtube-nocookie.com when a YouTube player is rendered/played. Google privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy ; YouTube terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms

Optional Vimeo videos load from player.vimeo.com with dnt=1 when a Vimeo player is rendered/played. Vimeo privacy policy: https://vimeo.com/privacy ; terms: https://vimeo.com/terms

Credits

The Liquid Glass lens model is an original implementation inspired by liqui.design and the article “Liquid Glass in the Browser” at kube.io; no third-party code is included.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor 3.25.0 or newer.
  2. Upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, then activate MoxKit.
  3. Open a page with Elementor and find the MoxKit Addons category.
  4. Open MoxKit > Header Footer to create and publish templates. Assign them in the Header & Footer Settings section on the same page. Choose MoxKit Full Width on the target pages.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. All MoxKit widgets and template assignment work with Elementor Free. Elementor Pro features such as its dynamic tags still require their own licenses.

Will this replace the header on every theme screen?

Only pages using MoxKit Full Width are replaced. Automatic assignment can apply that layout to standard pages. Posts, archives, search, 404 pages, WooCommerce special pages, and custom page layouts continue using the theme.

What happens when no header/footer is selected?

Automatic mode selects the newest eligible published template whose display rule matches. Choose the explicit fallback option to use a simple site-name header and copyright footer instead. If no eligible template exists, the fallback is used. MoxKit Full Width owns the page shell and does not call the theme’s header.php/footer.php.

How do I build headers and footers?

Open MoxKit > Header Footer and design your templates with Elementor containers and widgets. Use the Header & Footer Settings section on the same page to assign published templates to the MoxKit Full Width layout.

Are video providers contacted automatically?

With click-to-load enabled, the player stays inside an inert HTML template until the visitor clicks Play. YouTube or Vimeo receives a request when playback is requested. With click-to-load disabled, the player may contact the provider as the page loads. A configured remote cover image loads normally; upload your own image to keep it local.

Is my content deleted on uninstall?

No. Header and footer templates and your Elementor page data are kept, and they are back when you install MoxKit again. Deleting the plugin removes only its own settings (widget and extension switches, the header/footer assignment) and the post view counts. Remove templates from the dashboard first if you no longer need them. Change page layouts before uninstalling if you want to switch back to the theme.

How does Popular Posts know which posts are popular?

Choose Rank by: Most viewed (from the MoxKit Post View Counter under MoxKit > Extensions, or from another view counter plugin’s custom field), Most commented, Latest, Recently updated, or Random. Posts without any views yet are ranked by comments and then by date, so the widget is never empty while the counter warms up.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • New: Image Box widget with eight interactive banner designs; the whole box is one link.
  • New: Button presets (12), shapes (15), hover effects (16), icon animations, attention loops, and click effects.
  • New: Navigation Menu on phones and tablets: toggle styles, panel animations (side, top, bottom, fade, circle), drawer width, page effects, staggered items, drill-down submenus, and a logo and button in the panel.
  • New: Navigation Menu on desktop: nine more pointers, hover dimming, hover-intent submenus, card and caret submenus with descriptions, badges, mega menus with image cards, vertical accordion and icon rail, search and a button, a sticky, shrinking, or hiding header, a transparent header, reading progress, and one-page scroll highlighting.
  • New: Testimonial with several quotes: 11 designs, grid, carousel, moving row, and avatar picker layouts, half-star ratings, highlighted words, and a rating summary.
  • New: Flip Box effects: jelly flip, liquid blob, paint drip, rising tide, frosted dissolve, and a swirl style for the liquid morph.
  • New: Team Member designs (caption strip, reveal, float, glass, side, ribbon), rating badge, and photo filters.
  • New: Advanced Image scroll reveals: liquid swirl, wipe, iris, diamond, curtain, blinds, tiles, and brush.
  • New: Custom Heading bar and brush markers that draw in from the left, right, or center.
  • Improved: The Flip Box liquid morph is smoother: soft, rounded distortion instead of torn edges, eased timing, and less work for the browser on each frame.
  • Changed: The open Navigation Menu dropdown on phones now spans the screen by default. Choose “Widget” under Dropdown width to keep the previous width.
  • Fixed: Video, Flip Box, and Image Box no longer collapse to zero width inside row containers.
  • Fixed: Liquid Glass, Waves, Shape Divider Animation, and Custom Cursor keep working after Elementor caches a page that was first rendered outside a normal visit (for example through the REST API).

1.3.2

  • Fixed: The 1.3.1 package on WordPress.org was still missing the Card Deck files, the Image Marquee Arc script, and the uninstall routine, which caused a critical error on sites with Elementor’s Nested Elements feature active.
  • Changed: A widget whose file is missing is now skipped instead of stopping the page, and a missing script or stylesheet no longer fills the PHP error log with warnings.

1.3.1

  • Fixed: The 1.3.0 package was missing the Card Deck files, the Image Marquee Arc script, and the uninstall routine, which caused a critical error on sites with Elementor’s Nested Elements feature active.
  • New: Every MoxKit widget has its own icon in the Elementor panel, drawn for MoxKit and sized to match Elementor’s icons.

1.3.0

  • New: Card Deck widget: a stack of cards that deals its front card to the back on a timer, by swipe, or with previous/next buttons and dots, with a pause button and pause on hover. Every card is an editable Container, so it can hold any widgets. Stack step, shrink, tilt, darkening, exit direction, speed, and card, button, and dot styles are adjustable.
  • New: Vertical Accordion designs: Strip tabs, Image reveal, Numbered spine, and Color block, next to the Classic title bar. Per-panel image, color, and title color; open on click or hover; the title hidden or shown in the open panel; the panel number beside the title, as a chip, or as a large background numeral; muted closed panels, a bottom shade over images, dividers, and a rounded group.
  • New: Vertical Accordion animation settings: panel duration and easing, and a content entrance (fade, rise, drop, slide, zoom, or blur) with its own duration and delay. Panels now close with an animation too, content keeps its final size while a panel grows so text no longer reflows on the way, and stacked and mobile panels open and close by height.
  • New: Image Marquee Arc (ellipse) shape: images travel along an arch or a bowl, with a per-device depth, optional tilt along the curve, and size and opacity toward the ends.
  • New: Image Marquee alignment (top, middle, bottom; left, center, right for the vertical marquee) per device, and an automatic image height for rows of mixed ratios.
  • New: Vertical Accordion panel number formats (01, 1, I, A) with text before and after, and number styling: typography, colors, opacity, offset, and chip padding, radius, and border.
  • New: MoxKit Waves wave height can be set per device.
  • New: Vertical Accordion with editable nested Containers: expanding desktop panels that work like tabs (or a stacked layout), responsive mobile headers on the Elementor breakpoints, per-device spacing, single or multiple open panels, library icons per title and for the open/closed indicators, title-number typography, keyboard controls, and reduced-motion support.
  • New: Post Categories widget: categories, tags, or any public taxonomy as a list (optionally nested), pills, cards, or count tiles; one icon for all or an icon, color, and name per term; post counts in three formats; a palette or one accent color; the current category highlighted; lift, slide, fill, or glow hover.
  • New: Popular Posts widget: rank by views, comments, date, last update, or random, filtered by category or tag and by publish date; numbered list, ranking, cards, image overlay, or featured layouts, stacked, side by side, or in a swipeable row with previous/next buttons; rank numbers in seven looks and four color schemes (one color, medals, a first-to-last blend, or a palette); date, views, comments, author, category, and reading time.
  • New: Post View Counter extension (off by default) that counts post views for Popular Posts; editors, previews, prefetches, and bots are not counted. Other view counter plugins can be used through their custom field.
  • Fixed: In the editor, a new Custom Heading text-mask image (or gradient, size, or font) did not show on animated words until the page was reloaded, and the text could stay empty while the image was loading.
  • Fixed: In the editor, Process Showcase connectors between rows did not follow changes to their thickness, gap, or speed until the page was reloaded.
  • New: Custom Heading rebuilt: the heading is made of parts, each with its own font, color, gradient, image text mask (background image showing through the letters), or outline, a highlighter or underline marker with its own color, height, position, corner radius, and width, and its own animation. Images can sit between words. The whole heading animates as one block or by part, word, letter, or typewriter, with 11 effects, triggers on scroll, every time it scrolls into view, on page load, or on hover, and looping float, pulse, wiggle, wave, flowing fill, shine, or spin. The eyebrow and description are gone (use separate widgets); headings already on your pages keep working unchanged.
  • New: MoxKit Waves extension for Containers and Sections (Style > MoxKit Waves): seamless animated wave dividers in six styles with up to three layers, per-layer colors and opacity, flow, flow with rise and fall, or liquid motion, top, bottom, or both. Enable or disable it under MoxKit > Extensions.
  • Changed: Each widget now loads only its own stylesheet plus a small shared one (3 KB) instead of one 86 KB file for all widgets.
  • Changed: Fewer database queries on every page: MoxKit settings load together with WordPress’s own settings, and the header/footer lookup reads only templates of the needed type.
  • Changed: Animated Shape Dividers pause while they are off screen.
  • Changed: Deleting the plugin now removes its settings and the post view counts (on every site of a network). Templates and page content are kept.
  • Fixed: In the editor, each change to a Countdown left the previous timer running.
  • New: Animated Shape Divider extension for Containers and Sections (Style > Shape Divider Animation): a seamless flow (the shape is rebuilt so its ends meet), tide, breathe, or sway per side, with direction, speed, strength, a second layer for depth, and pause on hover. Enable or disable it under MoxKit > Extensions.
  • New: Advanced Rating can use any icon from the Elementor Icon Library, with an optional separate icon for unfilled ratings (for example a solid and an outline star).
  • New: Chart vertical bars can show the label and value beside each bar, on the right or left: across at the bottom of the bar (label above value, like a vertical progress bar), next to its top, or up along the bar. A track color draws a full-height rail behind each bar, and bars can be as thin as 2% of their slot.
  • Fixed: Custom Cursor in the Elementor editor only followed the pointer over widget content, not across the whole Container.
  • New: Advanced Rating widget: stars, rounded stars, hearts, circles, or any library icon on a 1–10 scale; exact, half, or whole-icon fill; scores as 4.6, 4.6/5, 4.6 out of 5, or 92%; title and review count; three layouts; fill, pop, and rise entrance animations; icon hover effects.
  • New: Custom Cursor extension for Containers (Advanced > Custom Cursor): 18 browser cursors, or a dot, trailing ring, ring, blend circle, spotlight glow, text bubble, or image that follows the pointer, with trailing, link-hover, and click effects. Enable or disable it under MoxKit > Extensions.
  • New: Chart horizontal bars with the label left, right, or above the bar and the value at the bar end, inside the bar, on the opposite side, or next to the label; track color, row spacing, and label column width.
  • New: Chart value prefix and suffix; value position above the bar or point, inside the bar, above or below the label, or left or right of the label; long labels wrap or are cut off with side spacing; Donut Center shows the total or custom text with a caption and its own typography, colors, and background.
  • New: Accordion open/close animations (slide, slide + fade, zoom, rise, drop, blur, 3D unfold) with duration and easing.
  • New: Accordion Title box with Normal, Hover, and Open tabs for title color, background, border color, and shadow.
  • New: Process Showcase badge border type and an adjustable outer ring.
  • Changed: Chart values and labels are HTML text, so they keep their real font size and the Site Settings global fonts at any chart width.
  • Fixed: Image Marquee and Text Marquee links did not respond on the repeated copy that keeps the loop seamless.
  • Fixed: Chart labels overlapped, and value and label sizes shrank or grew with the chart width.
  • Fixed: Icon colors, including the Secondary color on hover, were replaced by the Site Settings link colors when the icon had a link.
  • Fixed: Process Showcase badge border stayed invisible until a border color was set.
  • Fixed: Navigation Menu was hidden on the live page whenever a pointer effect was selected.

1.1.0

  • New: Icon widget with Elementor library icons in default, stacked, or framed styles; layered filled pulses, outline ring pulses, glow, and a turning dashed ring; looping icon animations and hover effects; full style controls.
  • New: Liquid Glass extension for Containers (Style > Liquid Glass) with nine presets, customizable refraction, bezel, blur, edge shine and radius, a frosted fallback outside Chrome and Edge, and per-device options. Enable or disable it under MoxKit > Extensions.
  • New: Flip Box liquid morph effect (ripple, melt, or wave), click/tap/keyboard trigger, Front and Back Background and Background Overlay (image, gradient, opacity, blend mode, CSS filters), and full typography, padding, border, shadow, and alignment controls.
  • New: Counter (formerly Statistic) with the icon on the left, right, top, or bottom, a styleable content box, ten number animations (count up with easing, odometer, slot machine, scramble, typewriter, wave, flip, drop, blur focus, none), and prefix/suffix styling.
  • New: Process Showcase per-step buttons with icons, number or icon + number badge markers with advanced badge styling, responsive columns, connectors that continue, snake, or fade between wrapped rows, animated connectors (light beam, flowing dashes, travelling dot, draw on scroll), and step box width, margin, and styling in every layout.
  • New: Chart color modes (single, per item, gradient) with per-item overrides that accept global colors, bar thickness and rounded corners, smooth lines, point styles (hollow, filled, ring, square, diamond, none), area fills (vertical, horizontal, or blended item colors), entrance animations for bars, lines, areas, and donuts, and a chart box.
  • New: Accordion icons from the icon library (closed and open), animated plus/minus and chevron indicators, eleven hover animations, and a full Icon style section.
  • New: Advanced Image now mirrors Elementor’s Image widget (image resolution with srcset, attachment captions, media file link with lightbox, width, max width, height, object fit and position, opacity and CSS filters for normal and hover), plus Ink bleed and Liquify scroll reveals, Spin 360 loops, and a reveal duration.
  • New: Missing style controls added to Countdown (finished message), Steps, Statistics, Team, Video, Pie Chart, and Pricing.
  • New: MoxKit widgets show Material Symbols icons and a “mox” badge in the Elementor panel.
  • Changed: Button box settings now live inside the Button section as padding and border radius; the padding default is shown and can go down to 0.
  • Changed: Chart, Advanced Image, and Icon previews in the editor are rendered by the server so they always match the live page.
  • Fixed: Accordion open indicator showed garbled characters.
  • Fixed: Chart bar colors ignored Elementor global colors.
  • Fixed: Flip Box did not load its script when it was the only MoxKit widget on a page.
  • Fixed: Pages kept showing cached widget markup after a plugin update; Elementor’s cache is now cleared once per update.
  • Security: Editor previews escape repeater titles and chart colors and only allow safe link schemes.

1.0.0

  • Initial Release with 22 customizable Elementor widgets.
  • WordPress Navigation Menu with horizontal/vertical layouts, library icons, hover effects, and responsive breakpoints.
  • Header Footer menu with template management and assignment settings.
  • MoxKit dashboard with individual widget switches, responsive styles, accessible controls, and click-to-load videos.

short_description: Twenty-nine Elementor widgets with liquid, flip and scroll effects, Liquid Glass, Custom Cursor, and a header/footer builder.

upgrade_notice.1.4.0: New Image Box widget, new Flip Box effects, and major Button, Navigation Menu, and Testimonial upgrades. The phone dropdown menu now spans the screen by default.
upgrade_notice.1.3.2: Fixes the critical error that 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 caused on sites with Elementor's Nested Elements feature active. Update now.
upgrade_notice.1.3.1: Fixes a critical error in 1.3.0 caused by files missing from the package, and adds new MoxKit icons in the Elementor panel. Update as soon as possible if you installed 1.3.0.
upgrade_notice.1.3.0: Adds Post Categories, Popular Posts (with an optional view counter), Vertical Accordion, a rebuilt Custom Heading, Advanced Rating, Custom Cursor, MoxKit Waves, and animated Shape Dividers. Chart text now uses its real font size: review charts tuned for the old scaled drawing.
upgrade_notice.1.1.0: Adds the Icon widget and Liquid Glass. Button box background, border, and shadow were removed (use the Normal/Hover colors); Advanced Image keeps the chosen image size (set Width to 100% for the old look); area charts default to a gradient fill.
